title: A proof of Gautschi's conjecture on subrange Jacobi polynomials
summary: Let $π_n$ be the monic polynomial of degree $n$ orthogonal on $[-c,c]$, $0<c\leq1$, with respect to the Jacobi weight $(1-x)^α(1+x)^β$, where $-1<α<β$. Gautschi conjectured that \[ \left[ \frac{π_n(-c)}{π_n(c)} \right]^2 \left(\frac{1-c}{1+c}\right)^{β-α} <1. \] By his variation formula, this inequality is sufficient for every positive zero of $π_n$ to move to the right as $c$ increases. For $0<c<1$, a first-crossing argument proves the conjecture throughout $0<α<β$. Together with the earlier regions recorded by Gautschi and established by Milovanović, this settles $β\geq0$.
